name: claude-seo
description: Universal SEO skill for Claude Code. 26 sub-skills + 19 sub-agents covering technical SEO, E-E-A-T, schema, GEO/AEO, agent readiness (Lighthouse Agentic Browsing, WebMCP, llms.txt), backlinks, local SEO, e-commerce, international SEO, Google APIs, and PDF/Excel reporting. 9 optional extensions for live SEO data.
one_liner: A free, comprehensive SEO audit toolkit for an AI coding assistant — checks technical SEO, site speed, structured data, and even how well AI search engines like ChatGPT can find and cite your site.
buyer: A solo SEO freelancer or small marketing agency who wants to run thorough, consistent audits for clients without hiring extra analysts or buying several expensive SEO tool subscriptions.
business_use_cases: An SEO freelancer runs it against every new client site as the first deliverable, turning a normally multi-hour manual audit into a same-day paid report.
A small marketing agency standardizes all client onboarding on this audit, then upsells ongoing SEO and 'AI search visibility' optimization retainers.
A local-business web developer bundles a 'Google and AI-search ready' audit into every site build as a premium add-on.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a one-time SEO + AI-search-readiness audit report to small-business website owners.
Offer an ongoing monthly SEO monitoring retainer built on top of the free audit, re-running it and tracking improvement over time.

steal_this: Run a full audit against three local businesses' websites this weekend and cold-pitch each owner a paid fix-it report based on the results.
